## Exploration

- {{< iconify fa6-solid book-open size=18px >}} Read chapters one and two in
[The Joy of Cryptography](https://joyofcryptography.com/)

## Activities

- {{< iconify fa6-solid people-line size=18px >}} **Monday and Wednesday**: The
one-time pad and provable security
- {{< iconify fa6-solid people-line size=18px >}} **Friday**: Complete a
computer security check
  - Complete a form-based assessment on your laptop
  - Complete an in-person assessment with course instructor
- {{< iconify fa6-solid diagram-project size=18px >}} **Friday**: Laboratory
session
  - Explore the one-time pad and the meaning of perfect secrecy
  - Learn why reusing a key destroys a message's confidentiality
  - Understand the difference between secrecy and integrity
  - Continued highlighting of the concept of a "security synapse"
  - Instructor presentations that feature:
    - Explanation of a high-level concept behind provable security
    - In-class activity that connects concepts to real-world scenarios
    - Hands-on examples of the operation and behavior of the one-time pad
  - Demonstrate the [Security Survey Project Two: Cryptography
    Benchmarking](/../projects/)
    - Show `cryptobenchmark` measuring `Fernet` and `rFernet`
    - Report preliminary time and space overheads from the doubling experiment
